3 6" 3+ 13

值时，如果该特工位于杀戮区内，如果有 2 名或更

XV26 SHAS’VRE
3 6" 3+ 13
For the Greater Good: Whenever determining the value of
Accurate X for the Kauyon faction rule, if this operative is in
the killzone, add 1 to the result if 2 or more friendly XV26
STEALTH BATTLESUIT operatives (excluding DRONE) are
incapacitated (to a maximum of Accurate 3). Note that you must
have a minimum of Accurate 1 to use this rule.

标记光：当一名敌方特工是该特工的有效目标时，或者当一名敌方特工对该特工可见，并且位于己方埋伏
标识的 2" 内时（详见准备埋伏战略计谋）那名敌方特工被标记。每当一名己方 XV26 隐形战斗服特工对
一名被标记的敌方特工进行射击时，那名特工的远程武器拥有“严重”武器规则。请注意，就算该特工不
是活跃特工，其他特工依旧可以成为该特工的有效目标。
XV26 隐形战斗服、钛帝国、标记者 32

Markerlight: Whenever an enemy operative is a valid target for this operative, or is visible to this operative and within 2" of your
Ambush marker (see Prepare Ambush strategy ploy), it's marked. Whenever a friendly XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative
is shooting an operative that's marked, that friendly operative’s ranged weapons have the Severe weapon rule. Note that an operative
can be a valid target for this operative even if this operative isn't the active operative.

XV26 标记者
3 6" 3+ 12
标记光聚焦 1AP
选取一名对该特工可见的敌方特工。在本回合中，当一名己方XV26 隐形战斗服特工向那个敌方特工
射击时，你可以使用此效果。若你如此做，则在那次行动结束前，那名己方特工数据卡中的远程武器的
命中属性提升 1 点。
该特工不能在敌方特工的控制范围内执行本行动。
XV26 隐形战斗服、钛帝国、标记者 32

Select one enemy operative visible to this operative. Once during this turning point, when a friendly XV26 STEALTH
BATTLESUIT operative is shooting that enemy operative, you can use this effect. If you do, improve the Hit stat of ranged
weapons on that friendly operative’s datacard by 1 until the end of that action.

cards.text:
APL 移动豁免耐伤
XV26 指引者
3 6" 3+ 12
电子干扰发射器：每个转折点限制一次，在一名敌
方特工执行射击行动，并在对手选择了有效目标时
（无人机除外)，如果该特工不位于敌方特工的控制
范围内，那么您可以使用本规则。若使用，那么直
到那次行动结束前，每当一名敌方特工对位于其 2"
外，并且位于该特工 3" 内且对其可见的己方 XV26
隐形战斗服特工进行射击时：
• 忽略“穿刺”武器规则。
• 那名己方特工被遮挡。
定位信标: 在每个战略阶段的就绪步骤中，当您获得
CP 时，如果己方定位信标标识被放置于杀戮区内，
掷一枚 D6，己方定位信标每位于一个目标标识 6"
内，便为掷骰结果增加 1 点。若结果为 5+，您获得
额外一点 CP。
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
XV26 LODESTAR
3 6" 3+ 12
Electrochaff Launcher: Once per turning point, when an enemy
operative is performing the Shoot action and your opponent
selects a valid target (excluding DRONE), you can use this
rule, providing this operative isn’t within control range of enemy
operatives. If you do, until the end of that action, whenever
an enemy operative is shooting a friendly XV26 STEALTH
BATTLESUIT operative that’s both visible to and within 3" of
this operative and more than 2" from that enemy operative:
• Ignore the Piercing weapon rule.
• That friendly operative is obscured.
Homing Beacon: This operative is carrying your Homing Beacon
marker. Operatives (excluding DRONE) can perform the Pick
Up Marker action on that marker. The first time an enemy
operative performs the Pick Up Marker action on your
Homing Beacon marker, discard that marker (remove it from
the battle).
In the Ready step of each Strategy phase, when you gain CP, if
your Homing Beacon marker is placed in the killzone, roll one
D6, adding 1 to the result for each objective marker your Homing
Beacon marker is within 6" of. If the result is 5+, you gain 1CP.

APL 移动豁免耐伤
XV26 消除者
3 6" 3+ 12
多光谱传感器系统：支援。每个转折点限一次，在
一名位于该特工 8" 内的敌方特工被激活时，您可以
使用本规则。每一名位于该特工 3" 内的己方 XV26
隐形战斗服特工可以立即执行以下一种行动：
• 执行一次无消耗的冲刺行动（按照您选择顺序进
行)。
• 更改命令。
每一名执行冲刺行动的己方特工不能移动进入敌方
特工的 3" 内。请注意，通讯装置通用装备只会影响
本规则的第二个距离限制。
系统干扰 1/2AP
选择一名对该特工可见的敌方特工。直到那名特
工的下一次激活结束前，那名特工的 APL 属性
减少 1 点。每当该特工拥有隐匿命令时，您必须
消耗额外 1 AP 来执行本行动。
该特工不能在敌方特工的控制范围内执行本行
动。
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
XV26 NEUTRALISER
3 6" 3+ 12
Multispectrum Sensor Package: SUPPORT. Once per turning
point, when an enemy operative within 8" of this operative
is activated, you can use this rule. If you do, each friendly
XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative within 3" of this
operative can immediately do one of the following:
• Perform a free Dash action (in an order of your choice).
• Change its order.
Each friendly operative that performs the Dash action cannot
end that move within 3" of an enemy operative. Note that a
Comms Device from universal equipment only affects the second
distance of this rule.
SYSTEM JAM 1/2AP
Select one enemy operative visible to this operative. Until the
end of that operative’s next activation, subtract 1 from its
APL stat. Whenever this operative has a Conceal order, you
must spend 1 additional AP to perform this action.
This operative cannot perform this action while within control
range of an enemy operative.

cards.text:
APL 移动豁免耐伤
MV15 火炮无人机
2 6" 4+ 7
名称攻击命中伤害武器规则
双联脉冲卡宾枪 4 4+ 4/5 无休
撞击 3 5+ 2/3 -
无人机:
• 该特工不能执行除了冲锋、冲刺、后撤、近战、
光子榴弹发射器、转移和射击以外的行动。
• 在判断对目标标识的控制权时，将该特工的 APL
属性视作为比原本要低 1 点。请注意，这不是对
APL 属性的修正，因此任何修正会与本规则的效
果叠加。
• 该特工不能使用任何其数据卡上不存在的武器。
• 在判断该特工是否可见时，将模型顶部的圆盘视
作为模型的头部。
• 在该特工被残废和判断己方起始特工数量时，该
特工在对手的击杀/灭敌行动中被忽略。在判断需
要特工“逃离”、“存活”，或者被敌方特工残
废的胜利条件和 VP 获取方式时，这名特工将被
忽视（它是否逃脱/存活/被击杀，确认多少特工必
须逃脱/存活/被击杀等情况下)。
请继续阅读背面规则
XV26 隐形战斗服、钛帝国、MV15 火炮、无人机 28

Drone:
• This operative cannot perform any actions other than
Charge, Dash, Fall Back, Fight, Photon Grenade
Launcher, Reposition and Shoot.
• Whenever determining control of an objective marker, treat
this operative’s APL stat as 1 lower. Note this isn’t a change to
its APL stat, so any changes are cumulative with this.
• This operative cannot use any weapons that aren’t on
its datacard.
• Whenever determining what’s visible to this operative, the
round disc at the top of the miniature is its head.
• This operative is ignored for your opponent’s kill/elimination
op (when it’s incapacitated, and when determining your
starting number of operatives). It’s also ignored for victory
conditions and scoring VPs if either require operatives to
‘escape’, ‘survive’ or be incapacitated by enemy operatives (if
it escapes/survives/is incapacitated, determining how many
operatives must escape/survive/be incapacitated, etc.).

就算该特工不是活跃特工，其他特工依旧可以成为
该特工的有效目标。
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
MV75 MARKER DRONE
2 6" 4+ 7
Markerlight: Whenever an enemy operative is a valid target for
this operative, or is visible to this operative and within 2" of your
Ambush marker (see Prepare Ambush strategy ploy), it’s marked.
Whenever a friendly XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT
operative is shooting an operative that’s marked, that friendly
operative’s ranged weapons have the Severe weapon rule. Note
that an operative can be a valid target for this operative even if
this operative isn’t the active operative.

cards.title_zh: XV26 隐形战斗服杀戮小队
cards.image: 10-01-小队选择-XV26 隐形战斗服杀戮小队.png
cards.text:
XV26 隐形战斗服
杀戮小队
原型：渗透，侦察
特工
↘ 1 名 XV26 隐形战斗服火氏英雄特工，装备
有脉冲手枪和以下一个选项：
○ 速射炮或者融合炮
↘ 1 个 XV26 隐形战斗服 MV75 标记无人机
↘ 1 个 XV26 隐形战斗服 MV15 火炮无人机
↘ 4 名 XV26 隐形战斗服特工，从以下列表
中选择：
• 标记者
• 渗透者
• 解放者
• 指引者
• 消除者
除了渗透者特工以外，上述的每一名特工只能被
纳入您的杀戮小队一次。您的杀戮小队中只能包
含最多两个融合炮。
装备有以下一种选项：
• 速射炮；双拳
• 融合炮；双拳
cards.text_en:
XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUITS
KILL TEAM
ARCHETYPES: INFILTRATION, RECON
OPERATIVES
↘ 1 XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT
SHAS’VRE with pulse pistol and one of the
following options:
• Burst cannon or fusion blaster
↘ 1 XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT
MV75 MARKER DRONE
↘ 1 XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT
MV15 GUN DRONE
↘ 4 XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operatives
selected from the following list:
• DESIGNATOR • LODESTAR
• INFILTRATOR • NEUTRALISER
• LIBERATOR
Other than INFILTRATOR operatives, your kill
team can only include each operative on this list
once. Your kill team can only include up to two
fusion blasters.
With one of the following options:
• Burst cannon; fists • Fusion blaster; fists

cards.text:
XV26 隐形战斗服
阵营规则
考雍
在火氏所崇敬的军事哲学中，考雍是最为古老
的兵法，也备受 XV26 隐形战斗服小队的青
睐。考雍大致可以被翻译为“耐心猎手”，强
调将敌人引诱到陷阱之中，随后发起同步攻击
进行斩杀。擅长这种战略的火氏英雄能够同时
运用多个高机动资产，设计诸多应对手段和拖
延战术，将敌人引诱到埋伏之中，或者将他们
驱赶进入预先准备好的火力网络。
每当一名己方 XV26 隐形战斗服特工对一名敌
方特工进行射击时，其远程武器拥有“精准 X”
武器规则。X 的数值将取决于敌方特工所在的位
置。
敌方特工位置精准 X
位于己方领地 3" 内精准 1
位于己方领地内精准 2
位于己方降落区的 3" 内精准 3
cards.text_en:
XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT
FACTION RULE
KAUYON
Of all the principal martial philosophies revered by
the Fire caste, Kauyon is the oldest, and is greatly
favoured by kill teams of XV26 Stealth Battlesuits.
Roughly translated as the patient hunter, Kauyon's
tenets emphasise luring the enemy into overreaching
before striking at them with coordinated fury. Shas'vres
who are expert in this strategy employ multiple mobile
assets, layers of contingencies and delaying tactics
to draw foes into ambushes or corral them into pre-
prepared fire boxes.
Whenever a friendly XV26 STEALTH
BATTLESUIT operative is shooting an enemy
operative, its ranged weapons have the Accurate
X weapon rule. X is determined by that enemy
operative’s location.
ENEMY OPERATIVE LOCATION ACCURATE X
Within 3" of your territory Accurate 1
Within your territory Accurate 2
Within 3" of your drop zone Accurate 3

cards.text:
XV26 隐形战斗服
阵营规则
隐匿力场
每一个 XV26 战斗服和随行的特种无人机中都
安装有内置隐匿力场生成器。这种迷彩力场能
够将特工隐藏起来，让他们可以在穿越危险区
域时回避敌人的侦测。
每当一名己方 XV26 隐形战斗服特工拥有隐匿
命令时，那名特工对于其 3" 外的敌方特工不可
见（本规则的优先度高于其他所有规则)。
每当一名己方 XV26 隐形战斗服特工拥有隐匿
命令时，那名特工在执行后撤行动时可以少消
耗 1AP。
cards.text_en:
XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT
FACTION RULE
STEALTH FIELDS
Integral stealth field generators are built into each
veteran's XV26 battlesuit and the specialised drones
that accompany them. The camouflaging fields
they project mask a team's operatives, allowing
them to move through hazardous territory while
evading detection.
Whenever a friendly XV26 STEALTH
BATTLESUIT operative has a Conceal order,
it cannot be visible to enemy operatives more
than 3" from it (this takes precedence over all
other rules).
Whenever a friendly XV26 STEALTH
BATTLESUIT operative has a Conceal order, it
can perform the Fall Back action for 1 less AP.

cards.text:
XV26 隐形战斗服

光子榴弹发射器电子干扰发射器
指示物指示物
EMP 炸弹多目标追踪器埋伏标识
指示物指示物
多光谱传感器系定位信标
统指示物标识

XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT
MARKER/TOKEN GUIDE
Photon Grenade Electrochaff
Launcher token Launcher token
EMP Bomb Multitracker Ambush
token token marker
Multispectrum Homing Beacon
Sensor Package marker
token

cards.text:
XV26 隐形战斗服
战略计谋
耐心猎手
在允许敌人鲁莽地展现全力或者耗尽资源
后，智慧的猎人们能够趁虚而入。
每当一名己方 XV26 隐形战斗服特工对一名处
于待机的敌方特工进行射击或近战时，那名己方
特工的武器拥有“平衡”武器规则，并且那名特
工的远程武器拥有“集中”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT
STRATEGY PLOY
PATIENT HUNTERS
By allowing the enemy to recklessly show their hand or
exhaust themselves, the wise can exploit the foolhardy
aggression of the foe.
Whenever a friendly XV26 STEALTH
BATTLESUIT operative is shooting against or
fighting against an expended enemy operative,
that friendly operative’s weapons have the
Balanced weapon rule and its ranged weapons
have the Saturate weapon rule.

cards.text:
XV26 隐形战斗服
战略计谋
团结一致
隐形战斗服的驾驶员们能够从盟友的身上获
取力量和决心。
每当一名己方 XV26 隐形战斗服特工（无人机
除外）被激活时，如果那名特工位于另一名对
其可见的己方 XV26 隐形战斗服特工（无人机
除外）的 6" 内，您可以忽略任意或所有对第一
名特工 APL 属性的修正，并且选择以下一个效
果：
• 直到第一名己方特工的激活结束前，忽视受创
状态对其移动属性的任意修正。
• 直到第一名己方特工的激活结束前，忽视受创
状态对其武器命中属性的任意修正。
cards.text_en:
XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT
STRATEGY PLOY
BONDS OF UNITY
Stealth battlesuit pilots can draw strength and resolve
from comrades.
Whenever a friendly XV26 STEALTH
BATTLESUIT operative is activated (excluding
DRONE), if it's visible to and within 6" of another
friendly XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative
(excluding DRONE), you can ignore any changes
to that first friendly operative's APL stat and
select one of the following:
• Ignore any changes to that first friendly
operative’s Move stat from being injured until
the end of that activation.
• Ignore any changes to the Hit stat of that first
friendly operative’s weapons from being injured
until the end of that activation.

cards.text:
XV26 隐形战斗服
战略计谋
准备埋伏
钛星人预先计算好了射击方案并建立击杀
区域，等待着不知情的敌人走入完美的埋伏
空间。
将一枚埋伏标识放在完全位于己方领地内，并且
位于敌方特工 2" 外的位置。每当一名己方 XV26
隐形战斗服特工对位于标识 2" 内的敌方特工进
行射击时，您可以使用本规则。若这么做，直到
那次行动结束前，那名特工的远程武器拥有
“追踪”武器规则。在那次行动结束时，或在下
一个战略阶段的就绪步骤中（以先到者为准），
移除那枚标识。
cards.text_en:
XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT
STRATEGY PLOY
PREPARE AMBUSH
The T'au precalculate firing solutions and establish kill
field parameters, awaiting their unknowing opponents to
enter perfect strike range.
Place one of your Ambush markers wholly within
your territory and more than 2" from enemy
operatives. Whenever a friendly XV26 STEALTH
BATTLESUIT operative is shooting an enemy
operative that’s within 2" of that marker, you can
use this rule. If you do, that friendly operative's
ranged weapons have the Seek weapon rule
until the end of the action. Remove that Ambush
marker at the end of that action or in the Ready
step of the next turning point (whichever
comes first).

cards.image: 20-04-战略计谋-立体影像防御系统.png
cards.text:
XV26 隐形战斗服
战略计谋
立体影像防御系统
试验型图像投射科技的频繁闪烁能够迷惑
先进的瞄准系统，甚至老兵神枪手的精确
狙击。
每当一名特工对位于其 6" 外的己方 XV26 隐形战
斗服特工进行射击时，在掷攻击骰步骤中，攻
击者必须舍弃一枚尚未结算的普通成功（如果没
有普通成功，则舍弃一枚未结算的关键成功)。
本计谋的效果不能与遮挡规则的效果叠加。
cards.text_en:
XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT
STRATEGY PLOY
HOLOWAVE COUNTERMEASURES
Temporary bursts of experimental image-projection
technology can throw off advanced targeters and even
the aim of experienced snipers.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative more
than 6" from it, in the Roll Attack Dice step, the
attacker must discard one of their unresolved
normal successes (or one of their critical
successes if there are none). This isn’t cumulative
with being obscured.

cards.text:
XV26 隐形战斗服
交战计谋
反向矢量推进器
XV26 战斗服的驾驶员们十分擅长利用多方
位推进器来进行迅速的后退飞行，这种非
常规的移动手段能够使他们远离激进的敌
人，并令敌人暴露在其他小队成员的射击范
围内。
当一名敌方特工在一名己方 XV26 隐形战斗服
特工（无人机除外）的控制范围内结束一次冲锋
行动时使用本交战计谋。打断那次行动并使用本
规则。若使用，那名己方特工可以立即进行一次
无消耗的后撤行动，但是不能在那次行动中移动
超过 3"。这个行动不会被您对手的规则阻止（即
优先于所有此类规则）。随后，那名敌方特工可
以使用第一次冲锋行动剩下的任何距离立即执行
一次无消耗的转移行动，并且就算在执行了一次
防止其执行转移行动的行动后也可以这么做。
cards.text_en:
XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT
FIREFIGHT PLOY
VECTORED RETRO-THRUSTERS
XV26 battlesuit pilots are expert at firing unconventional
bursts from their multidirectional thrusters to rapidly
disengage from aggressive enemies, leaving their foe
vulnerable to the rest of the team.
Use this firefight ploy when an enemy operative
ends the Charge action within control range of a
friendly XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative
(excluding DRONE). Interrupt that action to use
this rule. If you do, that friendly operative can
immediately perform a free Fall Back action,
but it cannot move more than 3" during that
action. This action cannot be prevented by your
opponent’s rules (taking precedence over all
such rules). Then, that enemy operative can
immediately perform a free Reposition action
using any remaining move distance it had from
that first Charge action, and can do so even if
it’s performed an action that prevents it from
performing the Reposition action.

cards.text:
XV26 隐形战斗服
交战计谋
隐形幽灵
特工们时刻准备好将武器的动力转移给隐匿
力场，使他们在播下死亡之种后立刻消失。
在一名己方 XV26 隐形战斗服特工的激活结束
时使用本交战计谋。如果那名特工拥有交战命
令，将它修改为隐匿命令。您在每场战斗中对每
一名己方特工使用本计谋的次数不能超过一次。
cards.text_en:
XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT
FIREFIGHT PLOY
GHOSTSHROUD
Readily rerouting power from their weapons to their
stealth fields, these operatives appear to vanish after
sowing sudden death.
Use this firefight ploy at the end of a friendly
XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative’s
activation. If that operative has an Engage order,
change it to Conceal. You cannot use this ploy for
each friendly operative more than once per battle.

cards.text:
XV26 隐形战斗服
交战计谋
喷气背包
XV26 战斗服的强力推进背包提供了出色的
机动性，让老兵驾驶员们能够快速占领有利
位置。
在一名己方 XV26 隐形战斗服特工（无人机除
外）被激活或者进行反应时使用本交战计谋。直
到那次激活/反应结束前，您可以忽略特工在一次
攀爬和一次跳落期间穿越的垂直距离。
cards.text_en:
XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT
FIREFIGHT PLOY
ENGAGE JET PACK
The potent jet packs built into each XV26 battlesuit
provide exceptional mobility, allowing their veteran
pilots to secure advantageous positions.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly XV26
STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative (excluding
DRONE) is activated or counteracts. Until the end
of that activation/counteraction, you can ignore
the vertical distance it moves during one climb
and one drop.

cards.text:
XV26 隐形战斗服
交战计谋
救世主协议
编辑在无人机中的硬代码将杀戮小队盟友
的安全放在了第一位，哪怕这么做会牺牲
自我。
在一名己方 XV26 隐形战斗服特工（无人机除
外）被选择成为一次射击行动的有效目标时使用
本交战计谋。选择位于那名己方特工 3" 内且对
其可见的一名己方 XV26 隐形战斗服无人机特
工，这名特工将代替成为有效目标（就算它在通
常情况下不能)。那名己方无人机特工只有在原
本的目标拥有掩护或者遮挡的情况下才能拥有对
应的增益效果。本计谋对拥有“爆炸”或“洪
流”武器规则的远程武器无效。
cards.text_en:
XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT
FIREFIGHT PLOY
SAVIOUR PROTOCOLS
The drones of this kill team are hard-coded to prioritise
the safety of their comrades, even at the cost of their
own existence.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly XV26
STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative (excluding
DRONE) is selected as the valid target of a
Shoot action. Select one friendly XV26 STEALTH
BATTLESUIT DRONE operative visible to
and within 3" of that first friendly operative
to become the valid target instead (even if it
wouldn’t normally be valid for this). That friendly
DRONE operative is only in cover or obscured if
the original target was. This ploy has no effect
if the ranged weapon has the Blast or Torrent
weapon rule.

cards.text:
XV26 隐形战斗服
阵营装备
XV26 多目标追踪器
这类辅助系统能够迅速生成射击方案，让战士
们能够使用速射炮向多个目标进行同时射击。
每个转折点限一次，在一名己方 XV26 隐形战
斗服特工执行射击行动，并且选择速射炮
（扫射）时，您可以使用本规则。若这么做，
选择下列之一：
• 直到那次行动结束前，那件武器拥有“洪流
2"”武器规则。
• 直到那次行动结束前，那件武器拥有“洪流
3"”武器规则，但您选择的次要目标不能超
过一个。
cards.text_en:
XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT
FACTION EQUIPMENT
XV26 MULTITRACKERS
These support systems rapidly generate targeting
solutions, enabling warriors to engage multiple targets
with their rapid-firing burst cannons.
Once per turning point, when a friendly XV26
STEALTH BATTLESUIT operative is performing
the Shoot action and you select a burst cannon
(sweeping), you can use this rule. If you do, select
one of the following:
• Until the end of that action, that weapon has
the Torrent 2" weapon rule.
• Until the end of that action, that weapon has
the Torrent 3" weapon rule, but you cannot
select more than one secondary target.

cards.text:
XV26 隐形战斗服
阵营装备
网络反制干扰器
这些装置所发射的次声波能够让群聚在一起的
敌人陷入混乱。在干扰了敌人的感官和通讯设
备后，战斗服的驾驶员们可以趁机制造破坏。
战略计划。选择一个目标标记或任务标记。直到
转折点结束时，每当确认那个标记的控制时，
若进行争夺的敌方特工中至少有一名位于己方
XV26 隐形战斗服特工 3" 内，则将进行争夺
的敌方特工 APL 总和视作降低 1 点。请注意，
这不是对 APL 属性的修正，所以任何修正均会
累加。
cards.text_en:
XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT
FACTION EQUIPMENT
COUNTER-NETWORK JAMMERS
Closely packed enemies can be thrown into disarray
with a burst of multiwave infrasound from these devices.
With the foe's senses and communications equipment
disrupted, even outnumbered battlesuit pilots can
exploit the resultant confusion to devastating effect.
STRATEGIC GAMBIT. Select one objective
marker or mission marker. Until the end of the
turning point, whenever determining control of
that marker, treat the total APL stat of enemy
operatives that contest it as 1 lower if at least
one of those enemy operatives is within 3" of
friendly XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT operatives.
Note this isn’t a change to the APL stat, so any
changes are cumulative with this.

cards.text:
XV26 隐形战斗服
阵营装备
先进黑日目镜
就算是在最为异常的遮挡环境中，安装有这类
先进观察系统的战斗服和无人机能够十分清晰
地辨别目标。
每当一名己方 XV26 隐形战斗服特工对一名被
遮挡的特工进行射击时，您不需要因为遮挡规则
舍弃一次成功。遮挡规则的其他所有效果将照常
生效。
cards.text_en:
XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT
FACTION EQUIPMENT
ADVANCED BLACKSUN FILTERS
Battlesuit and drone bodies augmented with these
advanced optical systems are granted incredible target
identification clarity, even if confronted by the most
unnatural and blinding of conditions.
Whenever a friendly XV26 STEALTH
BATTLESUIT operative is shooting an operative
that's obscured, you don't have to discard one
success as a result of that rule. All other effects of
obscured apply as normal.

cards.image: 40-04-阵营装备-内置目标锁定系统.png
cards.text:
XV26 隐形战斗服
阵营装备
内置目标锁定系统
这些瞄准系统会自动分析敌人的威胁等级并为
使用者自动进行锁定。它们可以被植入神经连
接或者驾驶员的体内。
每当您进行反应时，您可以使用一名拥有隐匿命
令并位于敌方特工 3" 外的己方 XV26 隐形战斗服
特工进行反应，但是在进行反应前，您必须将
特工的命令更改为交战命令，并且特工在那次反
应期间不能执行射击以外的行动。
cards.text_en:
XV26 STEALTH BATTLESUIT
FACTION EQUIPMENT
HARDWIRED TARGET LOCKS
These target-acquisition systems prioritise the
parameters of enemy threats and provide their user with
automatic locks. They may be embedded into neural
interfaces or implanted into pilots' bodies.
Whenever you would counteract, you can
do so with one friendly XV26 STEALTH
BATTLESUIT operative that has a Conceal order
and is more than 3" from enemy operatives, but
before it counteracts, you must change its order
to Engage and it cannot perform any actions
other than Shoot during that counteraction.
